scope: Angles ONLY — a claim family, what this brand argues. An angle is CHANNEL-FREE and FORMAT-FREE: the same claim runs as a paid static, an organic video, an email and a landing page. A thing that only works in one container is a FORMAT and belongs in a format bank, not here. An angle is aimed at exactly one core avatar and may serve several sub-avatars, declared per asset. The model: components/naming/MODEL.md
source: <where these came from — a teardown pass, a proven record, a workshop. Never blank.>
note: The one angle source for this brand. ONLY the brand's owner signs an angle active; a session may propose a candidate and may never sign one. An entry with no receipt that resolves is not an angle, it is a hope.

angles.id: <kebab-case, the claim family — never the headline>
angles.name: <the claim in a few words>
angles.what: <ONE sentence a customer could agree or disagree with. If you cannot write that sentence, this is not an angle.>

receipts.source: <a path that RESOLVES, or a dated quote from the owner. An unfollowable receipt is indistinguishable from a fabricated one.>
